source.title: Intergas Xtend Mono Installation Instructions — Hybrid air-water heat pump system, document 88302401 (V1.2, 2024)

faults.title: Storing: No flow in the CH circuit for at least 30 minutes.
faults.meaning: F-code (storing/fout). No flow in the CH circuit for at least 30 minutes.

faults.title: Storing: Value of external flow sensor T43 too high (>67°C) or Value of flow sensor T03 over 1 minute too high. (> 90 ºC)
faults.meaning: F-code (storing/fout). Value of external flow sensor T43 too high (>67°C) or Value of flow sensor T03 over 1 minute too high. (> 90 ºC)
checks: Check the flow in the system.

faults.title: Storing: Memory fault codes.
faults.meaning: F-code (storing/fout). Memory fault codes.

faults.title: Storing: Water temperature too low during defrost function.
faults.meaning: F-code (storing/fout). Water temperature too low during defrost function.
checks: CH flow too low. Check system flow.

faults.title: Storing: Heat pump type not correctly configured.
faults.meaning: F-code (storing/fout). Heat pump type not correctly configured.

faults.title: Storing: Incorrect serial number in memory module.
faults.meaning: F-code (storing/fout). Incorrect serial number in memory module.

faults.title: Storing: Incorrect firmware.
faults.meaning: F-code (storing/fout). Incorrect firmware.

faults.title: Storing: Firmware version not compatible
faults.meaning: F-code (storing/fout). Firmware version not compatible

faults.title: Storing: XTP controller internal
faults.meaning: F-code (storing/fout). XTP controller internal

faults.title: Storing: XTP controller configuration
faults.meaning: F-code (storing/fout). XTP controller configuration

faults.title: Storing: XTP controller communication
faults.meaning: F-code (storing/fout). XTP controller communication

faults.title: Storing: Startup
faults.meaning: F-code (storing/fout). Startup
checks: Switch off the power at the fused spur for 1 minute, the re-establish.

faults.title: Storing: Return sensor T04.
faults.meaning: F-code (storing/fout). Return sensor T04.
checks: Check for any breakages/short circuits in the wiring for the sensor T04.
Check whether the sensor T04 is connected correctly.

faults.title: Storing: Flow sensor T03.
faults.meaning: F-code (storing/fout). Flow sensor T03.
checks: Check for any breakages/short circuits in the wiring for the sensor T03.
Check whether the sensor T03 is connected correctly.

faults.title: Storing: External flow sensor T43.
faults.meaning: F-code (storing/fout). External flow sensor T43.
checks: Check for any breakages/short circuits in the wiring for the sensor T43.
Check whether the sensor T43 is correctly connected.

faults.title: Storing: External outdoor sensor T42.
faults.meaning: F-code (storing/fout). External outdoor sensor T42.
checks: Check for any breakages/short circuits in the wiring for the sensor T42.
Check whether the sensor T42 is correctly connected.

faults.title: Storing: Fault within the outdoor unit
faults.meaning: F-code (storing/fout). Fault within the outdoor unit
checks: Access the control screen for additional information
faults.note: Intergas publiceert hier geen Storingscode 2 of buitenunit-subcodes; aanvullende informatie staat volgens de handleiding in het WiFi-bedieningsscherm.

faults.title: Storing: Fault within the indoor unit
faults.meaning: F-code (storing/fout). Fault within the indoor unit
checks: Access the control screen for additional information

faults.title: Storing: Bypass mode active
faults.meaning: F-code (storing/fout). Bypass mode active
checks: Not a fault code as such, but a forced way to forward the heat request to the boiler.
Switch off the power at the fused spur then, press and hold the control button whilst re-establishing the power supply to clear the by-pass mode.

faults.title: Notificatie: Parameter settings outside range
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Parameter settings outside range

faults.title: Notificatie: System pressure too low, parameter P020
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). System pressure too low, parameter P020
checks: The system water requires refilling or topping up.

faults.title: Notificatie: No water pressure
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). No water pressure
checks: The system water requires refilling or topping up.

faults.title: Notificatie: XTP error heat pump (ODU)
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). XTP error heat pump (ODU)

faults.title: Notificatie: Communication with the outdoor unit has been lost or the outdoor unit has an internal .
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Communication with the outdoor unit has been lost or the outdoor unit has an internal .
checks: Access the Wifi control screen for additional information
Check the wiring between the indoor unit and outdoor unit for breakages/short circuit.
Check the connections in the outdoor unit.

faults.title: Notificatie: Condenser temperature too high: heating pump disengaged.
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Condenser temperature too high: heating pump disengaged.

faults.title: Notificatie: Thermostat not connected.
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Thermostat not connected.
checks: Connect the Comfort Touch thermostat; see §8.8.5.

faults.title: Notificatie: Crankcase heater function
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Crankcase heater function
checks: Possible loose connection to the outdoor unit

faults.title: Notificatie: Abnormal Delta-T between the flow and return temperature values
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Abnormal Delta-T between the flow and return temperature values
checks: Sensors T03 and T04 connected or mounted incorrectly.

faults.title: Notificatie: Problem with memory.
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Problem with memory.

faults.title: Notificatie: Fault memory module
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Fault memory module

faults.title: Notificatie: No flow in the CH circuit for at least 30 seconds.
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). No flow in the CH circuit for at least 30 seconds.
checks: Venting program (max. 15 minutes) is started. Other system functions are blocked and resumed after the program has completed.
If sufficient flow is regained again for 30 seconds, the program will stop and the notification code will clear.

faults.title: Notificatie: Problem with automatic flow rate control
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Problem with automatic flow rate control
checks: Probably air in the system, vent.

faults.title: Notificatie: System flow too low during commissioning
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). System flow too low during commissioning
checks: Check the CH-circuit for restrictions, debris, air or isolation valves closed.

faults.title: Notificatie: Remote flow system temperature sensor T43 gives an abnormal value
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Remote flow system temperature sensor T43 gives an abnormal value
checks: Check if the sensor is attached firmly.
Check the connector on the main print.

faults.title: Notificatie: Clock not set
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Clock not set

faults.title: Notificatie: Problem in the Clock operation
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Problem in the Clock operation

faults.title: Notificatie: Notification code that arises because the outdoor unit regularly experiences problems.
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Notification code that arises because the outdoor unit regularly experiences problems.

faults.title: Notificatie: Remote flow system temperature sensor T43 not installed.
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Remote flow system temperature sensor T43 not installed.
checks: Check in the WiFi control screen if; P066 = 4 (Boiler control On/Off), P123 = 1 (Yes), P123 = 3 (Adjustable relay output).

faults.title: Notificatie: Defrost is taking to long
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Defrost is taking to long
checks: Possible that the outdoor unit is fully exposed to the wind.

faults.title: Notificatie: Problem with external flow temperature sensor T43
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Problem with external flow temperature sensor T43
checks: Check the position and connection of the sensor on the flow pipework.

faults.title: Notificatie: Problem with external outdoor sensor T42
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Problem with external outdoor sensor T42

faults.title: Notificatie: Problem with refrigerant liquid sensor.
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Problem with refrigerant liquid sensor.

faults.title: Notificatie: Problem with refrigerant gas sensor.
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Problem with refrigerant gas sensor.

faults.title: Notificatie: Boiler locked out of system
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Boiler locked out of system

faults.title: Notificatie: Error with OpenTherm connection to boiler.
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Error with OpenTherm connection to boiler.

faults.title: Notificatie: Flow temperature from boiler is too low
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Flow temperature from boiler is too low
checks: Set the flow temperature of the boiler at least 10ºC higher then the system flow temperature of the Xtend (P194).

faults.title: Notificatie: Boiler not responding to heating request from Xtend.
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Boiler not responding to heating request from Xtend.
checks: Check whether the boiler or CH function is turned off.

faults.title: Notificatie: Boiler has a notification
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Boiler has a notification

faults.title: Notificatie: Boiler supplies too hot water during a heating demand.
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Boiler supplies too hot water during a heating demand.
checks: Check the set flow temperature of the boiler.
Check the set power of the boiler

faults.title: Notificatie: Thermostat firmware version is not up to date if using the Intergas Comfort Touch.
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Thermostat firmware version is not up to date if using the Intergas Comfort Touch.
checks: Install the latest version of Intergas Comfort Touch.

faults.title: Notificatie: Heatpump error (indor unit control)
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Heatpump error (indor unit control)
checks: Check the Wifi control screen for additional information

faults.title: Notificatie: Flow error during Heatpump operation
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Flow error during Heatpump operation
checks: Check the flow or the system water needs refilling or topping up.

faults.title: Notificatie: Flow error during defrost mode
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Flow error during defrost mode
checks: Check the flow or the system water needs refilling or topping up.

faults.title: Notificatie: Refrigerant temperature too low during defrost mode.
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Refrigerant temperature too low during defrost mode.
checks: Check the refrigerant circuit for leaks.

faults.title: Notificatie: Defrost mode stopped due to a water temperature that is too low.
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Defrost mode stopped due to a water temperature that is too low.

faults.title: Notificatie: Problem with the user interface.
faults.meaning: n-code (notificatie). Problem with the user interface.
